project_context.target_audience: Colony residents looking to book athletic spaces efficiently.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
spacing_and_layout.landing_page_grid: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with gap-8 to gap-12.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: MODE B: The 'Control Room' Grid. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gap-4 or gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.containers: All bordered containers MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense content and forms. Optical alignment over geometric.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]
surfaces_and_micro_themes.dashboard_cards: Tactile Neumorphism: Flat bg-neutral-900 with 1px border-white/5, subtle inner shadows, and sharp edges (rounded-md max).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.feature_cards: Grid Borders: border-collapse style, border-r border-b border-border/40.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white hover:bg-[#FF564E] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300

forms.input: bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 focus:border-[#FF3B30] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF3B30] text-white rounded-md px-4 py-3
forms.label: text-xs tracking-[0.1em] uppercase text-neutral-400 mb-2 block

components.library: Use Shadcn UI for interactive logic (Forms, Modals, Inputs, Dialogs) but heavily customize them with the above surface styles. Do NOT use standard Shadcn card appearance.

animations.hover: Explicitly set text color on hover. Lighter hue of active state.
animations.transitions: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO 'transition: all'.
animations.grid_items: If using framer-motion, the motion.div must be the direct child of the grid container.

icons.usage: Use bold or duotone weights for a high-end athletic feel.

images.description: Monochrome view of an empty indoor sports court. MUST use a heavy dark overlay (e.g., bg-black/50 or bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A] to-transparent) so white heading text is legible.
A young athlete jumping. Use in the 'About the Court' or 'Features' section.
Dark shuttlecock detail. Use for background textures or split-screen imagery.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Theme + Archetype 2: The Performance Pro.
Never use pure white backgrounds. The app background MUST be #0A0A0A.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to every button, form input, and key layout container.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for the landing page layouts to achieve the 'Tetris' grid asymmetry.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions like Datepickers, Selects, and Dialogs, but strip their default borders/backgrounds to match the 'Tactile Neumorphism' style defined here.
For slot bookings: represent the 9 slots clearly in the 'Control Room' grid layout. Ensure hover states on available slots show the #FF3B30 accent.
Never use placeholder images from dummy services. Only use the provided media URLs.
